items.title: Early Access Supporter Packs Leaving Soon
items.summary: It’s been almost two years since we released the Early Access Supporter Packs, and it’s time to say goodbye to them. In just a few weeks, they’ll be leaving the store permanently and will be replaced by five new Supporter Packs. So, if you’ve been thinking about purchasing or upgrading one of the current packs, now’s your last chance!

items.title: ExileCon 2026 Merchandise
items.summary: Attendees at ExileCon 2026 will have exclusive first access to a variety of new merchandise. This year, we’ve prepared more than 60 new goodies, including T-shirts, pins, keycaps, posters, plushies, and more. Take a sneak peek in this news post!
